business_problem: scale product and business analytics across billions of events and multiple petabytes while standardizing governance and making insight accessible beyond technical teams.
solution_summary: Miro uses Snowflake on Snowflake to scale product and business analytics across billions of events and multiple petabytes while standardizing governance and making insight accessible beyond technical teams. Application, customer, event, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so analysts, operators, and business teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. The platform also connects with AWS, dbt so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Miro achieved 70%+ Miro team members using data products built on Snowflake and 2 Petabytes processed to optimize Miro’s product and business.
